ON-VEHICLE INSPECTION

INSPECT RESISTANCE OF AIR FLOW METER

(a) Disconnect the air flow meter connector.

(b) Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between each terminal.

Between terminals | Resistance (Ω) | Temp. °C (°F)
E2 — VS | 200 - 600 | —
E2 — VC | 200 - 400 | —
E2 — THA | 10,000 - 20,000 | -20 (-4)
 | 4,000 - 7,000 | 0 (32)
 | 2,000 - 3,000 | 20 (68)
 | 900 - 1,300 | 40 (104)
 | 400 - 700 | 60 (140)
E1 — FC | Infinity | —

If the resistance is not as specified, replace the air flow meter.

(c) Reconnect the air flow meter connector.
